name: 3D / BIM modeling
scope: Architectural massing, framing and parametric models in connected modeling applications, starting with Rhino 9 and Grasshopper, by one agent or by several agents on one model split into files by owner.

coverage.limitations: Rhino 9 for Mac with an open document and a run_python tool: the Rhino AI panel, or another agent session connected to Rhino's tools. The skills that run helper scripts are plugin-only (the installed Arch Studio plugin, not hosted MCP), and a Rhino team needs the same plugin release on every machine. No rendering, structural analysis, construction documents or Revit/IFC export. Measured so far by the maintainers: test buildings in the Rhino 9 AI panel and in a headless harness, single runs; no with-skill workflow validation is claimed.

host_requirements: Rhino 9 with an open document and a run_python tool (the AI panel or another connected session)
the installed Arch Studio plugin for skills that run helper scripts

evaluations.claim: Manifest membership and portability only; not workflow acceptance
Team check logic on synthetic records, without Rhino; not workflow acceptance
The requirements checker on stub geometry, without Rhino; not workflow acceptance
